dataset.name: Phase 9B Multi-Paper Evaluation Dataset
dataset.description: RAG evaluation benchmark for 6 research papers: ResNet, BERT, Transformer, YOLO, MobileNets, and Pruning Survey. Covers Computer Vision, NLP, and Model Compression domains with factual, conceptual, and cross-paper synthesis questions.
